inner_panel_key.name: Anatomical inner thigh cotton ease
inner_panel_key.method: One editable fit against actual closed subdivided skin in armature rest position, 4.5 mm stand-off, stable cut-panel sides and graded medial/lower panel selection. Shared saddle controls remain joined.

saddle_support: Grade opposing thigh/shin influence into pelvis across upper central saddle, preserving total native bone influence.
lower_hem_clearance: Remove unsupported lower fade. Medial stand-off 4.5 mm; retained lateral stand-off 12 mm. No post-subdivision projection trial retained.

outer_transition.scope: Both outer panels, graded around the existing sharp upper-thigh crease.

inner_fold_bend_radius.scope: Graded cotton atlas region around the diagnosed inner-layer fold; symmetric front/rear and left/right support.

shell: Native normal extrusion, nominal 1 mm; inherited non-manifold constraints are not retained.
